# jsPDF 3.0.3

Pinned, unmodified UMD build for the static PVC workspace. MIT license included.

- Source: https://unpkg.com/jspdf@3.0.3/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parallax/jsPDF/v3.0.3/LICENSE

Loaded locally only when PDF export is requested. Uses text and PNG APIs only;
no optional HTML/SVG dependencies, CDN requests or design uploads.
